connectionParameters.label: Customer Key
connectionParameters.name: customer_key
connectionParameters.desc: Cisco Umbrella Enforcement API customer key

connectionParameters.label: Base URL
connectionParameters.name: base_url
connectionParameters.desc: Umbrella Enforcement API base URL (default: https://s-platform.api.opendns.com/1.0)

desc: Cisco Umbrella Enforcement connector for response actions. Submit a threat event to block a malicious domain via the Umbrella Enforcement API, list the domains currently in the enforcement block list, and remove a domain from the block list. Authentication is via a customer key.

functions.label: Block Domain / Submit Threat Event
functions.name: add_domain_event
functions.desc: Submit a threat event to the Umbrella Enforcement API to block a malicious domain. Umbrella validates the domain and adds it to the organization's enforcement block list for DNS blocking.

inParameters.label: Destination Domain
inParameters.name: dst_domain
inParameters.desc: The malicious destination domain to block (e.g., internetbadguys.com)

inParameters.label: Destination URL
inParameters.name: dst_url
inParameters.desc: The destination URL associated with the event (e.g., https://internetbadguys.com/a-bad-url)

inParameters.label: Event Severity
inParameters.name: event_severity
inParameters.desc: The partner threat level or rating (e.g., severe, high, bad)

inParameters.label: Event Type
inParameters.name: event_type
inParameters.desc: Common name or classification of the threat

inParameters.label: Event Description
inParameters.name: event_description
inParameters.desc: Variant or other descriptor of the event type

inParameters.label: Destination IP
inParameters.name: dst_ip
inParameters.desc: The destination IP of the domain in IPv4 dotted-decimal notation (e.g., 8.8.8.8)

inParameters.label: Source
inParameters.name: src
inParameters.desc: IP or hostname of the infected device

inParameters.label: Disable Destination Safeguards
inParameters.name: disable_dst_safeguards
inParameters.desc: If true, bypasses Umbrella Investigate validation of the domain (riskier). Default false.

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: The created event ID returned by Umbrella

functions.label: List Blocked Domains
functions.name: list_blocked_domains
functions.desc: Return the domains currently present in the Umbrella Enforcement block list.

inParameters.label: Limit
inParameters.name: limit
inParameters.desc: Number of domains to return per page (default and maximum: 200)

inParameters.label: Page
inParameters.name: page
inParameters.desc: The page number to start reading in the collection

functions.label: Remove Blocked Domain
functions.name: delete_blocked_domain
functions.desc: Remove a domain from the Umbrella Enforcement block list. Useful for false-positive remediation or unblocking legitimate domains.

inParameters.label: Domain
inParameters.name: domain
inParameters.desc: The domain name or numeric domain ID to remove from the block list. Domain IDs can be obtained from List Blocked Domains.
